class.name: FauxBuildView
class.brief_description: Presents the FauxBuild world through Godot rendering.

description.para: The rendering adapter for a FauxBuild world. It consumes world data produced by the core; it never becomes the authority for world state. In later milestones this node owns the camera adapter, GPU resources, shaders, the geometry cache, portal-visible instance state, render interpolation, and debug drawing.

Milestone M5 scope: disposable structural presentation. A C++ owner of a [code]StructuralWorld[/code] hands it to [method present_world] (a C++-only seam; a native world cannot travel through GDScript), and this node packs the accepted surfaces into at most five diagnostic [ArrayMesh] groups — Floors, Ceilings, SolidWalls, PortalUpper, PortalLower — as one [MeshInstance3D] child per non-empty kind. Vertices are copied verbatim in render space (float32 packaging of the core values only); triangles are appended with accumulated vertex offsets and are never re-derived, welded, reordered, or re-transformed. Presenting a new world discards and deterministically recreates the whole presentation; no generated mesh, scene, or cache may become world authority.
[code]true[/code] once a world has been presented successfully. Presentation state only — never world state.
Names of the non-empty diagnostic mesh groups currently presented, in canonical kind order (Floors, Ceilings, SolidWalls, PortalUpper, PortalLower). Useful for tests and debug UI.
